name: Kinpara Oshou
source:
The head priest of Shofukuji Temple, where Ennosuke is allowed to live.

He stands at 5'3" (~162cm)

He is a compassionate but serious person, and does not like it when strange people like Kuroji and Toukichi come to Ennosuke's aid.

He especially does not like Kurojii because of his occupation. He always lectures him every time they meet, telling him to get a decent job and hard work.
 
He is called "Oshou-sama" by Ennosuke, "Oju-ssan" by Kuroji, and "Osho-san/sama"  by others.
